task_description: Fix inconsistent realized Reward:Risk / per-trade P&L in smc_fvg_strategy.pine on XAUUSD (SL=4, TP Mode=RRR, RRR=10, Entry=Market). Root cause: opposite-direction reversal-netting under Pine's single net position (pyramiding stacks only same-direction entries; an opposite-direction strategy.entry closes open opposite trades at the reversal price, not their own from_entry SL/TP), which decouples realized P&L from the configured 4/40 distances. Fix by gating placeStrategyOrder to skip an entry that conflicts with an already-open opposite-direction position, so every filled trade exits via its own SL/TP and realized R:R matches configured RRR. Remaining variance from inherent bar-model gap slippage on a tiny SL is a settings/instrument reality (SL too small for gold's bar size), not a code bug. Edit only smc_fvg_strategy.pine; branch fix/rrr-consistency.

verification.summary: ITERATION 2 (addresses 2026-09-14-085513 review, NEEDS_CHANGES). No local Pine Script toolchain exists (no compiler/backtester), so build/test/docker are N/A. Verification is static Pine v5 semantics review: (1) the placement guard now gates on submitted/open direction as well as net position - posConflict = (isBull ? position_size<0 : position_size>0) AND a bounded, size-guarded scan of tradeOrders for any tracked order with isLong != isBull sets trackedConflict; directionOk = not posConflict and not trackedConflict wraps the entry+exit+tradeOrders.push block. This closes both residual reversal-netting paths the review flagged: SAME-BAR internal-vs-swing opposite entries (the earlier submission is already in tradeOrders when the second call scans) and PENDING-LIMIT opposite orders (a resting limit stays in tradeOrders until it closes). Same-direction stacking and flat entries still work; (2) exit tick math loss=slPoints/mintick, profit=tpDist/mintick, tpDist=RRR*slPoints unchanged so tpDist:slDist=RRR:1 preserved; (3) function still ends with trailing true, only local bools/loop-var assigned (no global scalar reassignment; tradeOrders read via .get and mutated via .push, both allowed), loop bounded and guarded, no break/continue; (4) git diff origin/main confined to placeStrategyOrder + its doc comment in smc_fvg_strategy.pine (single hunk) plus task-state files. Unrelated behavior (structure/FVG/projection/dashboard/VWAP/entry modes/cap) untouched. Review issue #3 is unresolvable locally: user MUST re-backtest XAUUSD (SL=4, RRR=10, Market) in TradingView.
